# Vendored files (used only to make the worry report PDF)

- `jspdf.umd.min.js`: jsPDF 2.5.2, MIT licence (see `jspdf-LICENSE.txt`). https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF
- `fonts/Inter-*.ttf`: Inter by Rasmus Andersson, SIL Open Font License 1.1. https://github.com/rsms/inter

They load only when someone taps "Send email" or "Download to device", so the rest of the app stays light.
